messages:
kate: deploy finished -> release/rlhf-quant v2.7.1; starting gradual rollout 12% (triggered via ci). changelog: https://ci.redwood/release/rlhf-quant/2.7.1

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: ALERT deploy-5xx-surge — service: inference-api — symptom: /v1/generate 5xx rate > 6% over 2m

pagerduty: PD incident INC-1719804321 created; paging alex (oncall)

alex: Acked. Jumping in. Moving to incident channel. Any quick signals whether this is infra or model? @maria can you triage?

maria: quick look: majority of 5xx are 503 from model workers timing out. Error traces show repeated accept() failures and short lived SIGPIPE on quant execution workers since rollout started. Not seeing OOMs.

ajay: kernel logs show an increase in broken pipe errors on nodes running the new quant path binary. Suspect userspace/kernel interaction with new ioctl flag in the v2.7.1 build.

kate: we have a feature-split. Can divert traffic from the new variant back to stable immediately. I can pause rollout and shift traffic. Recommend divert to stable 95% and pause.

alex: do it and confirm. Also prepare rollback plan but hold on for now.

kate: executing traffic flip now. command used:
```
# flip traffic to stable variant
curl -X POST https://console.internal/ff/traffic -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"service":"inference-api","variant":"stable-v2","split":0.95}'
```

ops-bot: traffic change accepted — change-id ff-20260314-91; update in progress

maria: enabling short circuit and lowering connect timeout to reduce retry pileups:
```
bash -c "kubectl -n inference patch configmap cb-config --patch '{\"data\":{\"cb_enabled\":\"true\",\"connect_timeout_ms\":\"800\"}}'"
```

pagerduty: Escalation timer: 3m until SRE lead escalation if mitigation not observed.

alex: paused rollout in console (paused at 12%). If error rate doesn't decline in 90s we rollback.

kate: pause confirmed. Could also kick an emergency rollback but hold while we watch metrics.

maria: monitoring — 5xx rate dropping: 7.2% -> 1.6% in 110s after traffic flip. p95 latency improving. Looks promising.

ajay: draining suspect quant nodes to collect logs and avoid more traffic hitting them:
```
kubectl cordon node/quant-05
kubectl drain node/quant-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

jess: pinging customer success. Drafting initial message for impacted customers: "We had a brief increase in failed requests for some long-streaming workflows after a deploy. Traffic was diverted to stable and the issue mitigated. We're investigating root cause and will share an update."

alex: PD escalation suppressed — mitigation verified. Keeping PD incident open for post-incident analysis. Assigning owners: maria (SRE) lead RCA, ajay infra remediation, kate eng release follow-up.

maria: creating IRT ticket IRT-6721 to collect artifacts (core dumps, kernel logs, worker traces). Will try to reproduce with the same kernel/quant combo in staging.

ajay: will build a patched node image that reverts the problematic ioctl usage and schedule a controlled rollout to quant pool + canary nodes.

ops-bot: handoff note created — next_oncall: ryan — handoff_ts: 1719807921

alex: handing off to maria/ajay for deeper work. I'll sign out in ~30m — ryan please watch the 5xx dashboards overnight. If 5xx > 3% re-page me. Good job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert condition cleared for deploy-5xx-surge — last state: resolved

pagerduty: PD INC-1719804321 remains open for timeline + postmortem; assigned owners listed in IRT ticket.

maria: preliminary notes: concentrated failures on long-context streaming sessions, peak failed requests ~1.9k in the 5-minute window, small number of customers impacted (will enumerate in RCA). Posting timeline and artifacts in IRT ticket in ~3-4 hours.

jess: customer note sent. Will follow up after RCA with impact summary + ETA for any remediation.

ryan: acked. I'll be on watch overnight. keep me posted if rollouts restart.

-- end of thread --
